description: Main application component for the WristFit virtual try-on frontend, managing camera view, gallery, and detection flow.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component handling the app's state and rendering.

methods.name: onCapture
methods.description: Handles image capture, triggers hand detection, manages loading state.

methods.name: onUploadSelected
methods.description: Handles user-uploaded images by invoking onCapture.

methods.name: onBackToCamera
methods.description: Resets the view back to the camera from preview.

methods.name: onComposed
methods.description: Handles final composed image data for sharing or saving.
